Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. The effect reads "up to 4," therefore you can place any number from 1 to 4.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card’s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to place just 2 cards in digivolution cards when I have 4 level 5 or lower [Argomon] in my trash?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. "Lv.-" Digimon don't have a level, therefore they can't be chosen as targets for an effect that deletes up to 4 levels' worth of Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to delete up to 4 levels' worth of Digimon, can I delete my opponent's "Lv.-" Digimon?

Card Q&A.a:
If a card is removed from the trash before a triggered [On Deletion] effect activates, that [On Deletion] effect can't be activated.
